name: Vashishtha Luxury Fashion Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Vashishtha Luxury Fashion Limited is engaged in the business of exporting high fashion hand embroidery work, accessories & finished garments.[1]
keyPoints:
Export Oriented Unit[1]
The company is a 100% Export House serving fashion brands in Europe, the UK, USA, Australia, and Turkey, offering customized apparel designs for couture and prêt-à-porter segments.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 48.2%
Debtor days have improved from 90.6 to 71.4 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -33.9%
